style: Industrial loft style: exposed red-brown brick wall, polished grey concrete floor, dark ceiling with exposed black steel beams and ducts, tall black steel-framed factory windows, black metal, worn leather, reclaimed dark wood, Edison bulb lights, a few green plants. Soft daylight from the big windows. Photorealistic real-estate interior photograph, eye-level wide-angle shot from a corner of the room, showing the floor, two walls and the ceiling. Uncluttered: every piece of furniture stands on its own with clear space around it, nothing overlapping. No people, no text, no logos, no watermark.
sameHouse: The reference photo shows another room of the same loft. Keep exactly the same floor, brick and wall finishes, ceiling, window style, light, colour palette and furniture style, and the same camera height and lens.
